decisions: Treat November 1 1B XRP as scheduled FinishAfter eligibility, not a completed release, sale or market supply.
Treat the trailing 12-month 70% re-escrow rate as a scenario prior only; preserve earlier varying monthly history as counterevidence.
Treat the 22.48B XRP exchange-wallet total as attributed custody inventory, not tradable float.

Record Binance's +196.2M overview delta as an inference likely representing a daily change, because rounded per-exchange deltas approximately reconcile to the +105.9M aggregate daily movement; do not admit it as a feature until the downloadable dataset confirms the interval.
Do not infer incident restitution, new XRP purchases or stolen-fund recovery from aggregate exchange-wallet changes.
Keep the latest verified TradRadar 20:10 UTC observation; reject the 17:45 UTC search-index result as stale.
Keep PR #1431 as a tested proposal only. Main's Cross Analysis writer remains active until an approved merge.
Admit no market feature and issue no directional XRP forecast from this pre-event snapshot.
required_verification: Retrieve a fresh validated XRPL ledger after 00:00 UTC and verify both escrow objects.
Capture EscrowFinish and follow-on transaction hashes, destinations, amounts, metadata and ledger indexes.
Identify subsequent EscrowCreate objects and quantify net escrow disposition.
Reconcile exact per-exchange daily delta from the machine-readable XRP Insights dataset.
Crosswalk incident source wallets against Binance reserve and attributed-wallet sets.
Synchronize post-event spot, depth, ETF, derivatives and exchange observations.
Run exact-head archive validation after metadata update.
